title: South Florida nightlife this week
igCaption:
Holiday lights, live music, and a Latin weekend out in South Florida.

Sources: The Palm Beach Post, Latin Times, Secret Miami, Ones To Watch, The Miami Guide

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #MiamiNightlife #PalmBeach
